svg.title: Azure RBAC scope: four levels, each inside the one above
svg.desc: Nested boxes with four levels. A management group contains two subscriptions. The first subscription contains two resource groups: one holds a virtual machine and a virtual network, the other holds a storage account. The second subscription contains one resource group that holds a virtual machine. A role assignment at any level applies to everything inside that box.
svg.text: Azure RBAC scope: four levels, each inside the one above
A role assignment at any level applies to everything inside that box. Lower levels inherit from higher levels.
Scope is the set of resources that an assignment applies to. The resources shown are examples.
Resources are the fourth level: the items inside a resource group. The root management group is the top of the tree.
